title: Vacuum Decay Rate in D-dimensional Electroweak theories
summary: We present a systematic framework for computing the functional determinant contribution to vacuum decay rates in D-dimensional electroweak theories. It consistently incorporates quantum fluctuations from scalar, fermion, and gauge fields while ensuring rapid convergence even at high angular momenta. Demonstrated through applications to the $D=4$ SMEFT and its $D=3$ thermal counterpart, our method provides a general and efficient tool for analyzing vacuum stability and decay across dimensions in the presence of new physics beyond the Standard Model.
